paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the Pass@8 accuracy (on the merged sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) for three different methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—as a function of generation temperature, ranging from 0.1 to 1.0 on a linear scale. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," spans from 0.1 to 1.0 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," ranges from 62.5 to 80.0 with tick marks at 2.5 intervals. The On-policy RL method is represented by a yellow line with triangle markers, starting at approximately 63.0 at temperature 0.1, rising to around 75.0 at 0.7, then dropping to about 72.0 at 1.0. The LUFFY method is shown with a red line and star markers, beginning at approximately 76.0 at 0.1, peaking at about 79.0 at 0.7, and ending at roughly 79.0 at 1.0. The SFT method is depicted by a dark teal line with inverted triangle markers, starting at about 75.5 at 0.1, dipping to approximately 70.0 at 0.5, rising to around 73.0 at 0.8, and finishing at about 73.0 at 1.0. The plot includes a grid for easier reading of values.
